### Loading and merging the data

```{python}
# Load data
database_url = os.getenv("DUCKDB_DB_URL")

con = duckdb.connect()
con.execute("INSTALL postgres; LOAD postgres;")  
con.execute(f"ATTACH '{database_url}' AS my_db (TYPE postgres, READ_ONLY);")

dc_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.naics_518_establishments").df()
near_dc_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.naics_518_nearby_estabs_50mi").df()
air_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.air_quality").df()
bus_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.business_patterns").df()
code_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.naics_code_look_up").df()
gdp_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.gdp").df()
inc_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.personal_income").df()
pop_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.population").df()
perm_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.res_construction_permits").df()
emp_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.unemployment").df()
county_df = con.execute("SELECT * FROM my_db.transformed.us_counties_spatial").df()
```


### Create final table

```{python}

final_bus_df = final_bus_df[final_bus_df["year"] != 2006] #drop 2006, it was only used to cacluated 2007's YoY change
```

### K-Means Clustering
```{python}
final_df["has_datacenter"] = final_df["datacenters"] > 0
y = np.log(final_df['datacenters'] + 1)


# cols_to_drop = ["datacenters", "county_id", "year", "has_datacenter", "datacenters_spatial_weighted_avg_5_log1p", "datacenters_per_100_sqmi", "nearby_datacenters_50mi", "nearby_datacenters_50mi_per_100_sqmi",
# "estabs_asinh", "estabs_asinh", "estabs_yoy_raw_diff", "estabs_asinh_growth", "estabs_spatial_asinh", "estabs_spatial_raw_diff", "estabs_spatial_asinh_growth","estabs_per_sqmi_log1p", "nearby_estabs_50mi_per_sqmi_log1p" ] 

cols_to_use = ["land_area_sqmi_log", "water_area_sqmi", "population_log"]

# X = final_df.drop(columns=[c for c in cols_to_drop if c in final_df.columns])
X = final_df[cols_to_use]

X_train_raw, X_test_raw, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.3, random_state=42)

qt = QuantileTransformer(output_distribution='normal', random_state=42)
X_train = qt.fit_transform(X_train_raw)
X_test = qt.transform(X_test_raw)

pca = PCA(n_components=0.85, random_state=42)
X_train = pca.fit_transform(X_train)
X_test = pca.transform(X_test)
```

```{python}
# save cluster lables to data frame for later use
train_clusters = kmeans.predict(X_train)
test_clusters = kmeans.predict(X_test)

kmeans_labled_df = final_df.copy()

kmeans_labled_df.loc[y_train.index, 'cluster_label'] = train_clusters
kmeans_labled_df.loc[y_test.index, 'cluster_label'] = test_clusters

kmeans_labled_df['cluster_label'] = kmeans_labled_df['cluster_label'].astype(int)

county_mode_cluster = (
    kmeans_labled_df
    .groupby('county_id')['cluster_label']
    .agg(lambda x: x.mode().iloc[0])
    .reset_index()
    .rename(columns={'cluster_label': 'county_mode_cluster'})
)

kmeans_labled_df = kmeans_labled_df.merge(
    county_mode_cluster,
    on='county_id',
    how='left'
)

kmeans_labled_df['cluster_label'] = kmeans_labled_df['county_mode_cluster'].astype(int)
kmeans_labled_df = kmeans_labled_df.drop(columns=['county_mode_cluster'])
```


### Add Treatment Flag

```{python}
# create columns to track if and when a county got its first dc
first_treated = (
    final_df[final_df["datacenters"] > 2]
    .groupby("county_id")["year"]
    .min()
    .reset_index()
    .rename(columns={"year": "first_dc_year"})
)

final_df = final_df.merge(first_treated, on="county_id", how="left")
final_df["first_dc_year"] = final_df["first_dc_year"].fillna(0).astype(int)

final_df["treated"] = (
    (final_df["first_dc_year"] > 0)
    & (final_df["year"] >= final_df["first_dc_year"])
).astype(int)

# Create relative time variable: t - first_dc_year (e.g., -2, -1, 0, 1, 2)
# Set never-treated (first_dc_year == 0) relative time to -100
final_df["rel_year"] = final_df.apply(
    lambda x: x["year"] - x["first_dc_year"] if x["first_dc_year"] > 0 else -100,
    axis=1,
)

final_df = final_df.merge(
    kmeans_labled_df[["county_id", "year", "cluster_label"]],
    on=["county_id", "year"],
    how="left",
)
```

```{python}
# create columns to track if and when a county got its first dc
first_treated_nearby = (
    final_df[final_df["nearby_datacenters_50mi"] > 112] # 73rd percentile
    .groupby("county_id")["year"]
    .min()
    .reset_index()
    .rename(columns={"year": "above_val_nearby_year"})
)

final_df = final_df.merge(first_treated_nearby, on="county_id", how="left")
final_df["above_val_nearby_year"] = final_df["above_val_nearby_year"].fillna(0).astype(int)

final_df["treated_nearby"] = (
    (final_df["above_val_nearby_year"] > 0)
    & (final_df["year"] >= final_df["above_val_nearby_year"])
).astype(int)

# Create relative time variable: t - first_dc_year (e.g., -2, -1, 0, 1, 2)
# Set never-treated (first_dc_year == 0) relative time to -100
final_df["rel_year_nearby"] = final_df.apply(
    lambda x: x["year"] - x["above_val_nearby_year"] if x["above_val_nearby_year"] > 0 else -100,
    axis=1,
)
```

```{python}
# split dataset into only cluster 0 obersvations and only cluster 1 observations

cluster_1_df = final_df[final_df["cluster_label"] == 1]
```

#### map counties in cluster 0 and 1

```{python}
# load counties map data
geojson_path = data_dir / "county_fips_codes/geojson_counties_fips.json"

with open(geojson_path, "r") as f:
    counties_geojson = json.load(f)
```

```{python}
combined_df = pd.concat(
    [
        cluster_0_df[["county_id"]].assign(cluster=0),
        cluster_1_df[["county_id"]].assign(cluster=1),
    ],
    ignore_index=True,
)

eda_table_name = "Counties Colored By Cluster"
cols_to_use = ["cluster"]

cluster_labels = {
    0: "0 (More Rural)",
    1: "1 (More Urban)"
}

cluster_colors = {
    "0 (More Rural)": "#C67A6D",
    "1 (More Urban)": "#5B8FA8"
}

for i in cols_to_use:
    value_col = i
    map_df = combined_df[["county_id", value_col]].dropna().copy()

    map_df["flag"] = map_df["cluster"].map(cluster_labels)

    fig = px.choropleth(
        map_df,
        geojson=counties_geojson,
        locations="county_id",
        color="flag",
        featureidkey="id",
        color_discrete_map = cluster_colors,
        category_orders={"flag": ["0 (More Rural)", "1 (More Urban)"]},
        labels = {"flag": "Cluster"}
    )

    fig.update_traces(
        marker_line_color="#F7F7F7",
        marker_line_width=0.1
    )
    
    fig.update_layout(
        title=dict(
            text=f"{eda_table_name}",
            x=0.5,
            xanchor="center",
            y=0.98,
            yanchor="top",
            pad=dict(t=0, b=0),
            font=dict(size=24)
        ),
        geo=dict(
            scope="usa",
            projection_type="albers usa",
            showland=True,
            landcolor="rgb(248, 248, 248)",
            showcountries=False,
            showlakes=False,
            bgcolor="rgba(0,0,0,0)",
            lonaxis=dict(range=[-125, -66]),
            lataxis=dict(range=[24, 50])
        ),
        legend=dict(
            title_text="",
            x=0.98,
            xanchor="right",
            y=0.25,
            yanchor="middle",
            bgcolor="rgba(255,255,255,0.75)",
            font=dict(size=18)
        ),
        margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=0, b=0),
        width=900,
        height=450
    )

    
    ## Make it look nice
    fig.write_image("../poster_plots/clusters.png", width=900, height=450, scale = 1)

    fig.show()
```

```{python}
    "real_gdp_2017_dollars_thousands_per_capita_log",
    "pm25_mean_daily_avg",
    "pm25_mean_daily_avg_spatial_weighted_avg_5",
    "tot_employee_count_industrial_per_capita_log1p",
    "tot_employee_count_information_per_capita_log1p",

]

for i in outcomes:
    results, es_df = mlu.create_DiD_model(cluster_0_df, i)
    print(f"Data centers impact on {i}, cluster 0: {es_df.loc[5, "effect"]} {es_df.loc[5, "conf_int"]}")
    mlu.DiD_coeff_plot(es_df, i)

    results, es_df = mlu.create_DiD_model(cluster_1_df, i)
    print(f"Data centers impact on {i}, cluster 1: {es_df.loc[5, "effect"]} {es_df.loc[5, "conf_int"]}")
    mlu.DiD_coeff_plot(es_df, i)

    results, es_df = mlu.create_DiD_model(cluster_0_df, i, first_treat = "above_val_nearby_year")
    print(f"Nearby data centers impact on {i}, cluster 0: {es_df.loc[5, "effect"]} {es_df.loc[5, "conf_int"]}")
    mlu.DiD_coeff_plot(es_df, i, "Nearby Data Center")

    results, es_df = mlu.create_DiD_model(cluster_1_df, i, first_treat = "above_val_nearby_year")
    print(f"Nearby data centers impact on {i}, cluster 1: {es_df.loc[5, "effect"]} {es_df.loc[5, "conf_int"]}")
    mlu.DiD_coeff_plot(es_df, i, treatment_type = "Nearby Data Center")
```

```{python}
# figures to save for poster

for cluster in [cluster_0_df, cluster_1_df]:
    if cluster is cluster_0_df:
        cluster_num = 0
    else:
        cluster_num = 1
    # Air quality
    results, es_df = mlu.create_DiD_model(cluster, "pm25_mean_daily_avg")
    mlu.DiD_coeff_plot(es_df, "pm25_mean_daily_avg", save = True, clean_name = "PM2.5 Mean Daily Average", cluster_num = cluster_num)

    # Personal Income
    results, es_df = mlu.create_DiD_model(cluster, "personal_income_thousands_of_dollars_per_capita_log")
    mlu.DiD_coeff_plot(es_df, "personal_income_thousands_of_dollars_per_capita_log", save = True, clean_name = "Log Personal Income", cluster_num = cluster_num)

    # Unemployment
    results, es_df = mlu.create_DiD_model(cluster, "unemployment_rate_pct", first_treat = "above_val_nearby_year")
    mlu.DiD_coeff_plot(es_df, "unemployment_rate_pct", treatment_type = "Nearby Data Center", save = True, clean_name = "Unemployment Rate (%)", cluster_num = cluster_num)
```
